title: Samson's Birth

questions.question: Who oppressed Israel for forty years before Samson?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:1 (ESV): "...and the LORD gave them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years."

questions.question: To whom did the angel of the Lord appear first?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:3 (ESV): "And the angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her..."

questions.question: What was the child to be from the womb?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:5 (ESV): "...for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb..."

questions.question: What was Manoah's wife forbidden to drink?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:4 (ESV): "Therefore be careful and drink no wine or strong drink..."

questions.question: What did Manoah do when his wife told him about the man of God?
options: He prayed to the Lord to send the man again
questions.correctAnswer: He prayed to the Lord to send the man again
questions.explanation: Judges 13:8 (ESV): "Then Manoah prayed to the LORD and said, 'O Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us...'"

questions.question: Why did Manoah ask the angel's name?
options: So that when his words came true, they might honor him
To name his son after him
questions.correctAnswer: So that when his words came true, they might honor him
questions.explanation: Judges 13:17 (ESV): "...'What is your name, so that, when your words come true, we may honor you?'"

questions.question: What was the angel's response about his name?
options: Why do you ask my name, seeing it is wonderful?
questions.correctAnswer: Why do you ask my name, seeing it is wonderful?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:18 (ESV): "...'Why do you ask my name, seeing it is wonderful?'"

questions.question: What did Manoah offer to the Lord?
options: A young goat and a grain offering
questions.correctAnswer: A young goat and a grain offering
questions.explanation: Judges 13:19 (ESV): "So Manoah took the young goat with the grain offering and offered it on the rock to the LORD..."

questions.question: How did the angel depart?
options: He went up in the flame of the altar
questions.correctAnswer: He went up in the flame of the altar
questions.explanation: Judges 13:20 (ESV): "...the angel of the LORD went up in the flame of the altar..."

questions.question: Where did the Spirit of the Lord begin to stir Samson?
options: In Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol
questions.correctAnswer: In Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol
questions.explanation: Judges 13:25 (ESV): "And the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol."

questions.question: What did Manoah fear would happen because they had seen God?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:22 (ESV): "And Manoah said to his wife, 'We shall surely die, for we have seen God.'"

questions.question: How did Manoah's wife reason that they would not die?
options: If the Lord had meant to kill them, He would not have accepted the offering or shown them these things
questions.correctAnswer: If the Lord had meant to kill them, He would not have accepted the offering or shown them these things
questions.explanation: Judges 13:23 (ESV): "But his wife said to him, 'If the LORD had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering...'"

questions.question: Manoah was from which tribe (clan)?
questions.explanation: Judges 13:2 (ESV): "There was a certain man of Zorah, of the tribe of the Danites..."

questions.question: What does the text imply Manoah and his wife did not know at first?
options: That he was the angel of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: That he was the angel of the Lord
questions.explanation: Judges 13:16 (ESV): "...For Manoah did not know that he was the angel of the LORD."

questions.question: What is the meaning of the name Samson?
questions.explanation: Historically, Samson (Shimshon) is derived from the Hebrew word for sun (Shemesh).

key_verse_text: ...for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb, and he shall begin to save Israel from the hand of the Philistines. (ESV)
